execution.method: Fresh, read-only public-web execution under the installed client-audit skill; not derived from the prior Stage 2 intelligence artifact.

findings.claim: The owned site presents a clear multi-service facilities and infrastructure proposition with visible quote calls to action.
Arc's owned pages publish materially inconsistent scale figures, including 500+ versus 5,000+ completed projects and 20+ corporate clients versus 500+ satisfied clients.
The facility-management page publishes outcome claims such as 15-30% savings, 99%+ uptime and under-two-hour response without visible methodology or independent substantiation on the sampled page.
The site states that its services are ISO certified, but no standard, certificate number, issuing body, scope or validity date was visible on the sampled owned pages.
The contact page provides a general business email, phone numbers, locations and a quote route; it does not name a decision maker or signing authority.
SPOTA AI is deliberately labelled Coming Soon in navigation; the earlier interpretation that it was stray placeholder residue is contradicted.
The homepage displays client names or logos and named testimonials, but this audit did not independently verify the underlying relationships or results.
Sampled competitors expose clearer combinations of company history, team or certification context, legal identity, locations and procurement-oriented trust detail than Arc exposes consistently.
No supportable decision maker or signing authority was established from the approved public sources used in this audit.
Exact official social profiles, review-platform standing and local-search performance were not established within the bounded audit.

contradictions.resolution: unresolved; do not select either published figure as fact
the prior placeholder-residue interpretation is superseded by the observed Coming Soon label

limitations: No form was submitted and no contact was made.
No authenticated analytics, Search Console, CRM or hosting data was available.
Performance, mobile rendering and form-delivery behavior were not measured in a browser lab.
Owned-site scale, certification, client and performance claims remain self-reported unless explicitly described as independently verified.
Competitor review was bounded and is not a complete market ranking.
unknowns: Which published project and client counts are accurate.
Whether the ISO claim is current and what standard and scope apply.
Who owns the enquiry route and has signing authority.
Whether the quote form submits, confirms and reaches an owner reliably.

route_test.reason: The strongest approved problems are owned-surface credibility, proof consistency and conversion-path assurance. The audit found no verified visibility, workflow or operating-system deficit strong enough to displace this route.

entry_offer_hypotheses.hypothesis: A bounded owned-claims and procurement-trust reconciliation across the homepage, mission, service and contact surfaces.
entry_offer_hypotheses.validation_needed: Arc must identify the authoritative project, client, coverage and certification facts.

entry_offer_hypotheses.hypothesis: A quote-route integrity review covering render, submission, confirmation, ownership and the published response promise.
entry_offer_hypotheses.validation_needed: Testing submission requires separate authorization because it creates contact.
